caption: The video captures a stationary wide view of a snow-covered granite valley. A sheer cliff face rises on the left and a rounded peak on the right, framed by foreground conifers heavy with snow. A thick band of mist fills the valley floor between the slopes, and a thin vertical streak of a waterfall is faintly visible on the right. Over time, the pink-and-lavender clouds overhead slowly drift and reshape, with the blue gap in the upper center changing its form and position. The valley fog swirls and shifts in density, alternately thickening over the mid-ground slopes and the base of the right-hand peak, then thinning to partly reveal and re-veil the waterfall streak. The granite faces and the snow-laden trees remain steady in the view, consistent with a largely fixed camera. The cloud and mist motion appears already underway and continues without a clear beginning or end.
